properties.w: The Songhai Empire fell to Morocco in 1591. This area was then split between the Moroccan Pashalik of Timbuktu and smaller successor states; the source keeps the old outline.
Toyotomi Hideyoshi unified Japan in 1590; Tokugawa Ieyasu won the battle of Sekigahara in October 1600.

properties.w: The last Mạc rulers held Cao Bằng, under Ming and then Qing protection, until 1677.
Jurchen tribes, which the Ming counted as its frontier guards, and the Tungusic peoples of the Amur. The Ming ruled only Liaodong.
No country owned Svalbard until the 1920 Svalbard Treaty. The source drew it inside Norway.
